deep_analysis:
Condition re-verified from candles.db: BTC crossed **above** EMA300 at 10:11 and held 5 closes — the prior cycle's urgent exit trigger has reversed. Writing the merge with a retraction.
```
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
TRADE WATCHDOG — WARNING
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

Open Trades: 1 (1 long, 0 short) — BTC #16358, 7.5h, -0.09%, trail never armed
Unrealized PnL: -0.01 USDT | 24h realized: +0.22 USDT / 9 closes
Regime: sources DISAGREE — regime_5m (10:00) SHORT_BIAS 5L/76S vs candles.db
   BTC ABOVE EMA300 since 10:11 vs continuum AT/STRONG_UP. auto_trader CHOP.
   Flip rate agg 24 / BTC 23 per 24h = p50–p95 STANDING STATE, not an anomaly.

── Steers ──────────────────────────────────────
🔴 RETRACTED — "EXIT BTC LONG #16358 (24 consecutive 1m closes below EMA300)".
   Condition reversed at 10:11 UTC (close 81756.5 vs EMA300 81745.5), held 5
   closes through 10:15 — verified in candles.db. Do NOT exit on that trigger.
🟡 [stale] BTC #16358 never armed after 7.5h; TP needs +0.645% vs BTC 1h range
   0.25–0.39%. Condition: un-armed at 12:44 UTC → cut flat. 8h flag 10:44 UTC.
   age=2 cycles unexecuted.
🟡 [cluster] 6 of 8 pendings are LONG vs aggregate 5L/76S. Hold while
   aggregate != LONG_BIAS; re-test BOTH halves next cycle (sources disagree).
🟢 [health] steer-001 confirmed: bb-bounce-v2-long+ 7d 21T/10W, -0.56.
🟢 [opportunity] Pick window opens 10:35 — HYPER LONG precheck PASS queued.
   ATOM SHORT (09:50) is DEAD: RSI 56.3 → 32.1, knife-blocked <35.

── Deep Analysis ───────────────────────────────
The single position is a 7.5h chop trade that can't arm: trail needs +0.40%,
BTC delivers 0.25–0.39%/h sideways. Precheck's own advisory on every candidate
today: "BTC AT EMA300 ~100m — chop pin, mid-band entries have no edge."

Wrong side, but the correction is not "flip short." 7d book pays SHORT (+0.02
vs LONG -3.02), yet BTC has paid nobody either way (31T/12W, -0.26) — the
winning side on BTC is no trade or trail-armed trend entries, and this is
neither. ai-trader-pending LONG is 0W/6 over 7d: exactly our pair.

The prior urgent exit was re-tested and reversed. It was retracted, not
re-issued — a third copy would have exited on reverted evidence. What remains
is a time condition on the trade (hour-10 un-armed cut), which legitimately
stands with age.

── Recommendations ─────────────────────────────
1. Don't exit #16358 on the retracted trigger; re-opens only if 1m closes
   drop below EMA300 (~81747) for 15+ closes. Else cut at 12:44 UTC.
2. No LONG adds while aggregate = SHORT_BIAS; re-test both halves next cycle.
3. 10:35 window: queue HYPER LONG. ATOM SHORT is dead — never report a pick
   as FIRED while AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False.
4. steer-001 → brain auditor (watchdog doesn't touch signal parameters).
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

Merged into `watchdog_recommendations.json` (automated `steers` untouched), no new pick (29 min into the 45-min window), memory stored, committed `b8b58d29`, pushed via canonical script.

**Sideways finds:**
- 🟡 **`price_collector` freshness gate covers only half the charted universe** — `price_age_minutes()` reads `latest_prices`, whose sole writer is `upsert_prices_from_allMids` (Hyperliquid allMids). 89/176 tokens with live 1m candles have no/stale row, including top-ATR coins SOPH (2.60%) and REZ (0.99%). Not a bug (likely un-executable on HL), but the Step-2 ATR screen is misleading for picks — screen against the fresh-tokens list instead.
- 🔴 **`push_gh.py` prints a GitHub token prefix to stdout** (`Using token: ghp_...`) — that lands in session transcripts and `trade-watchdog.log`, which is exactly the BUG-036 leak class. Suggest redacting to `Using token: ghp_***`.

- regime_5m scanner, 10:00:08Z: aggregate overall = SHORT_BIAS (long_bias 5 / short_bias 76 / neutral 42) AND regimes.BTC = SHORT_BIAS, confidence 61.7, slope -0.023%, price 81644.5 — both keys agree. LONG_BIAS coins: SOPH, TON, HYPER, BABY, PURR (5 of 123).
- continuum, 10:14:41Z: BTC price 81787 vs ema300 81759 = AT; linreg_direction LEAN_BEAR; trend_quality STRONG_UP; market_phase DECLINING; wyckoff UNKNOWN; volume LOW. Its consecutive_below counter reads 96 while ema300_position reads AT — the counter is stale relative to the cross, so the position field, not the counter, is authoritative here.
- independent candles.db 1m / EMA300 (verified this cycle): last UP-cross at 10:11 UTC (close 81756.46 vs EMA300 81745.50); 5 consecutive closes above through 10:15 (81812.6 vs 81746.7, +0.08%). This is the source that overturned the prior exit trigger.
- auto_trader shadow, 10:14: CHOP, MANAGE_ONLY, score long 0 / short -10, record 0/5 (all five losses in CHOP, all shadow_sl).
- watchdog regime_summary, 10:14: btc_15m SHORT_BIAS, btc_4h SHORT_BIAS, volatility LOW, zscore NEUTRAL, velocity SLOW, acceleration FLAT, volume LOW, linreg_alignment 0.5, market_phase DECLINING, trend_quality STRONG_UP.
- 15m regime log, last 6 aggregate readings: SHORT 08:45, SHORT 09:00, LONG 09:15, LONG 09:30, SHORT 09:45, SHORT 10:00.

Flip-rate KPI (mandatory): aggregate 24 flips/24h, BTC 15m 23 flips/24h over 96 dumps. That sits between p50=19 and the p95 anomaly threshold=26 — the STANDING STATE, not an anomaly; the old '>=6 = high churn' line is vestigial and satisfied by 100% of the last 14 days. Average direction state survives ~1h, so every direction-flavored steer in this file is condition-worded and re-tested next cycle. The informative tail (<6 flips = real trend tape, the one cheap place for snapshot-directional prose) has not occurred since Oct 2.

Sources currently DISAGREE: regime_5m says SHORT_BIAS, candles.db says BTC has been above EMA300 since 10:11, continuum says AT/STRONG_UP. No single-source directional assertion is made this cycle; both halves of the LONG-hold condition must be re-tested before the disagreement resolves.

Practical read: low-vol chop pin with BTC sitting on EMA300 (~100m by the precheck's own advisory). The one open position is a long, the aggregate still says short, and neither side has an edge until the pin resolves. Nothing here supports adding exposure in either direction.
